review_evidence: Reviewed all 987 primary Lean files (329,953 lines, 9,592 declaration-like commands); the Complexitylib tree formalizes machine models, P/NP/randomized/space classes, circuit complexity, Cook-Levin/SAT, languages and descriptive complexity.

Validation, Experimental and internal modules remain retained because they contain checked definitions, invariants, correctness statements and proof infrastructure that can supply formalization prior art.

Complete scripts/AxiomGuard.lean inspection shows a CI/meta audit: it imports the library, lists headline declaration names, traverses the environment, computes axiom dependencies and emits diagnostics; the mathematical declarations it names are all owned by retained Complexitylib modules.

rules.content_invariant: This exact script is CI/meta-level axiom-audit and theorem-name smoke-test machinery; it defines no unique object-level computational-complexity theorem or specification, and every referenced headline theorem remains in retained Complexitylib modules.
evidence: Complete file inspected directly against the hydrated source snapshot.
rules.rationale: The axiom guard is a CI/meta audit over declarations already defined in retained Complexitylib modules, not an independent computational-complexity formalization surface.

summary: Reviewed complexitylib; retain the computational-complexity formalization and validation modules, excluding only the CI axiom-audit script.
